title: [Main]-Prepayment amounts are incorrectly recalculated in statistics after partial posting when Prepmt. Amt. to Deduct Excl. VAT is manually adjusted
summary: Fixed prepayment amount recalculation in sales line statistics that was causing incorrect amounts after partial posting when prepayment deduction exceeded the invoiced amount.
key_points: Added CapPrepmtLineAmountAfterOverDeduction procedure to constrain recalculated prepayment line amount when deduction exceeds both invoiced and proportional amounts
Prevents posting failures with 'prepayment invoices not posted' error when prepayment line amount became inconsistent
Stabilizes statistics values across multiple opens and closes of the statistics page
Change applied across W1 and 11 localization layers with regression tests added
Triggered by ReleaseSalesDocument VAT recalculation flow during partial posting
quote: Prepayment amounts are incorrectly recalculated in statistics after partial posting when Prepmt. Amt. to Deduct Excl. VAT is manually adjusted.
